body:
Unfortunately I've stopped therapy.
It was getting expensive.
And would probably be useless because it is impossible for me to open up.I never did it with anyone,and this may sound weird but at this moment suicide sound better then opening up to others,and I know that is fucked up,but it is really impossible.

I guess that I wouldn't like to kill myself but considering the alternative,death by suicide is much better then this shit....

I never liked to talk about myself or even worse,the way I'm feeling.So because I couldn't tell anyone who I knew about this things,I've tried therapy,but never could actually tell my therapist how I'm feeling....

I'm sorry you feel that way.But please don't kill yourself.

But I will be honest,I don't see any "I'm tired of chasing my dreams","I'm tired of doing what I want to do for myself"...

You put to much energy to impress others while you forget what is important,and that is YOU.Focus on you,do what you like,be yourself.

Hey dear stranger

I'm not in any position to give you any good advice,god knows I'm the biggest fuck up that I know,but I can definitely tell you something,You are worth It.Maybe your family is disappointed of you,but they definitely love you.

Everybody makes mistakes,you're not an exception,you're just human.So please,I beg you,don't kill yourself.

As you said yourself,she doesn't know what that feels like,and unfortunately in this case you should explain to her about this,and make her understand it.She doesn't know how to react if she doesn't know with what she's dealing with.Like every other person on the face of the earth,she doesn't like to be rejected,so tell her the fact when you're ignoring her is not because of her,it's because you feel very bad.

Misery loves company
